name: xerox-punk
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a black-and-white photograph run through a photocopier three times. Pure bitmap feel — blown white highlights, crushed solid blacks, almost NO mid-tones left.
· NOISE: violent high-frequency grain and toner speckle across the entire frame, coarsest in the mid-greys. Edges break up into dots.
· CONTRAST: extreme. Skin reads as white paper with black shadow shapes rather than as tone.
· OVERLAY: one flat HOT MAGENTA six-pointed starburst with long sharp rays, opaque, sitting on top of the photocopy and bleeding off the frame edge. Flat vector colour, no shading.
· CROP: the subject fills the whole frame and is cut by all four edges.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
